subject: reasoning
question:
Statement: All laptops are devices. Some devices are pricey. All pricey things are taxed.

Conclusions: I. Some devices are taxed. II. Some laptops are pricey?
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/044d2a30c5b9908a70013d3ae96e804bf608ce90f9b94d8e89a1aed704adf348.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some devices are taxed. → Follow (As some devices are pricey and all pricey things are taxed. As some part of devices is common with pricey which whole comes in taxed, therefore it is true.)

II. Some laptops are pricey → Does not follow (As all laptops are devices and some devices are pricey. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
